title: Jab's World Simple
description: This modpack is for Jab's World, a vanilla-like SMP. The simple version of the modpack contains game optimizations, shader and other visual improvements. Unlike the complex version, there is no extra mods for technical building.
body:
The purpose this modpack is to enhance gameplay on the Jab's World SMP Server. 

It include elements enhancing performace such as [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium), game enginge changes like [Sound Physicis Remastered ](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-physics-remastered) and an ingame map through [Xaeros World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map).
